description: Polygon pairs for the lib/geometry.esm agreement tests (generated by scripts/gen-geometry-template-pairs.py; do not edit). Each group is one (document, ring stack, ring stack, manifold) a document clips: ring_a / ring_b are [cells, nv, 2] lon-lat stacks (the document's cells cells_a / cells_b) and each pair names cells (i, j) of them, 1-based, with an exact (planar) or 40-digit (spherical, steradians) reference area. A `padding_of` group is its sibling with every ring padded by two repeated vertices; the template must give the sibling's bits there. Tolerance: CONFORMANCE_SPEC 5.8.2, |A - A_ref| <= atol + rtol * A_ref with rtol 1e-9 and atol 1e-15 * R^2, R = max(1, largest |coordinate|) planar, 1 spherical.
